findings.desc: currentRunBasisMatches fails open when freshness recomputation is unavailable. The ledger basis may contain headHash/materialHash/storyFilesHash from run start, but packages/main/src/core/lattice-autopilot.ts:807-820 only reports drift when both the recorded hash and the freshly recomputed hash are truthy; if currentGitHead/currentMaterialHash/currentStoryFilesHashExcludingOutputs returns undefined (wrong git root, missing .git, git failure, or ls-tree failure), the function returns matches:true. autopilotResume then treats staleReason as empty at packages/main/src/core/lattice-autopilot.ts:1789-1824 and can return resume_ready for a run whose basis freshness could not be verified. This contradicts the M1 fail-closed requirement for stale/corrupt state and is not covered by packages/main/src/tasks/autopilot-resume-smoke.ts, which covers changed/stale values but not unavailable freshness probes. SourceRefs: packages/main/src/core/lattice-autopilot.ts:807-820; packages/main/src/core/lattice-autopilot.ts:1789-1824; packages/main/src/tasks/autopilot-resume-smoke.ts:221-267.
